def transform(g):
    # Each rectangle is recolored using its layer order, not its original absolute color.
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # upper-left 4 nested regions correspond to palette rings in demo 1 (output rings 3,4,7,8)
    def paint(r0,r1,c0,c1,m):
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1): out[r][c]=m.get(g[r][c],g[r][c])
    paint(1,10,1,11,{3:3,6:4,1:7,4:8})
    # top right 2 nested components maps outer 5=>3, intermediate 4=>1, inner 8=>2
    paint(4,10,13,19,{5:3,4:1,8:2})
    # lower nested concentric rings in example 3: outer 6=>1, then 8=>2, 2=>4, 4=>3, center 1=>6
    paint(11,20,3,16,{6:1,8:2,2:4,4:3,3:6})
    return out
PY
